description: Source code for managing channel users in Mattermost CLI, including commands to add and remove users from channels.

methods.name: channelUsersAddCmdF
methods.description: Function to add users to a channel based on command-line arguments.

methods.name: addUserToChannel
methods.description: Adds a user to a specified channel.

methods.name: channelUsersRemoveCmdF
methods.description: Function to remove users from a channel, either specific users or all users.

methods.name: removeUserFromChannel
methods.description: Removes a specific user from a channel.

methods.name: removeAllUsersFromChannel
methods.description: Removes all users from a specified channel.
